items.headline: PVH reported Q1 2026 results, beat EPS guidance, and cut full-year revenue outlook to flat amid tariff and Middle East-related headwinds
PVH announced executive leadership changes to support its PVH+ growth plan and core brands Calvin Klein and TOMMY HILFIGER
SueWallSt says it initiated an investigation into PVH after the stock fell sharply following the company’s June 3 earnings and guidance update
